narrative: Material PL1__M375AD40 exhibits smooth, high-volume daily demand averaging 942 units with a CV of 0.38, well within the Normal distribution regime. Lead times are moderately variable (CV=0.42, mean 2.71 days), with transport variability as the dominant risk factor. A continuous-review (r,Q) policy is recommended: the EOQ of ~5,971 units significantly reduces ordering frequency versus the current MOQ-constrained SAP setting of 643, cutting annual costs by 71.5%. A safety stock of 2,016 units is introduced to cover demand and lead-time variability at the 95% service level, replacing the current zero-buffer SAP configuration.
warnings: SAP safety stock is 0 — no buffer against variability at 95% service level target.

research_insights.selection_rationale: Smooth, near-continuous daily demand with high non-zero fraction (94.7%) and Normal distribution makes a continuous-review (r,Q) policy optimal. The EOQ formula minimises total cost, and a fixed reorder point handles the moderate lead-time variability efficiently without requiring a periodic review overhead.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Storage capacity is not binding: SS(2016) + OQ(5971) = 7987 units vs. limit of 17,466 — 55% headroom available. No capacity-driven reduction required.
